# StakeDXF plot object library

Plan-view symbols extracted from the **Three Pillars – Phase 1C** civil set
(Google Drive folder shared for Pheasant Farm / related sheets):

| Source sheet | Objects taken |
| --- | --- |
| `C7.00 DETAILS` | Fire hydrant, sanitary/storm manholes, cleanout, catch basin, curb/field inlet, silt fence, inlet protection |
| `C7.01 DETAILS` | Rip-rap, flared end / pipe grate, handicap parking sign, curb & sidewalk context |
| `C7.02 DETAILS` | Bollard, dewatering / filter bag, inline drain |
| `C7.03 DETAILS` | Additional construction details (library annotations) |
| `C6.11 SIGNAGE PLAN` | STOP, YIELD, DO NOT ENTER, ONE WAY, speed limit, NO OUTLET, ped/bike crossing |
| `C3.0 EROS CTRL` | Silt fence, wattles, inlet protection patterns |

## In the app

**Export Points → Plot objects → Add from object library**

For each placed object you can:

- Snap to a stake point or enter N/E
- Nudge N/S/E/W
- Scale (0.25×–5×)
- Rotate (−180°–180°)
- Recolor (preset palette)
- Optional custom label

Symbols draw as vector graphics on the staking plot PDF (not raster detail sheets).

## Source thumbnails

`source_C7.*.png`, `source_C6.11_SIGNAGE.png`, `source_C3.0_EROS_CTRL.png` are low-res
overviews of the source sheets used to curate the library.
